content.short: BrownFi is a capital-efficient AMM deployed across several EVM chains including HyperEVM and Monad.
content.description: BrownFi is an AMM aimed at ordinary liquidity providers, using a pricing curve it claims reaches around a hundred times the capital efficiency of Uniswap v2. Providers get flexible market-making parameters without having to manage a concentrated range by hand. The AMM is live on Hyperliquid, Monad and Base.
content.meta: One capital-efficient AMM curve deployed across HyperEVM, Monad, Berachain, Linea and Base.
